needed.suggestion: Install a pedestrian crossing with signals to improve safety on the right side.
Introduce a refuge island on the left side to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
Install a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to enhance pedestrian safety due to the wide road.
Enhance street lighting at the crossing for better visibility during nighttime.
